hook: Lowered onto a fishing boat plowing through whitecaps.
narration: The rescue swimmer dropped toward a fishing boat plowing through whitecaps.
A nineteen-year-old aboard the fishing vessel Ginger needed a medevac, eight miles west of San Nicolas Island.
An Air Station San Francisco Dolphin crew came to get him.
The boat keeps moving into the wind, so the helicopter can hold a steady hover beside it while the cable pays out.
On deck, the swimmer went to work beside the fishing crew.
Then the patient lifted off the deck in a rescue litter.
Up it came, swinging over the white water.
outcome: The Dolphin crew flew the young man to Torrance Memorial Hospital in Torrance, California.
title: Swimmer lowered onto a boat in whitecaps
description:
On June 20, 2020, a Coast Guard Air Station San Francisco MH-65 Dolphin crew medevaced a 19-year-old man from the fishing vessel Ginger about 8 miles west of San Nicolas Island, California, and flew him to Torrance Memorial Hospital.
